title: appname.workflowManifest.v1
description: Schema FOR tests/workflows/WNN-*.yaml — the machine form of the Part 41 acceptance workflows (Artifact-Pack Brief §4 format). One manifest per W1–W27 catalog entry; steps are the exact command sequence where Part 41 gives one, with UI-harness steps flagged.

workflow.description: catalog id W1..W27 (file names zero-pad: W01-layered-editing.yaml)

name.description: kebab-case slug matching the file name stem

tier.description: primary tier per §41.8 (W1/W2 = per-pr; touched-area additions per the §41.7/§41.8 tables; nightly = full catalog; weekly = W19 full)

runner.description: the Part 41 Runner column; cli = headless (§26.3), ui-harness = scripted UI (§34.6/§31.5)

milestoneGate.description: the §41.8 'Milestone gate' column / §37.1 slice the workflow gates, e.g. "1.0"

fixtures.description: empty/absent for script-built fixtures (e.g. W14: none — built from doc.new)

preconditions.description: the Part 41 Preconditions line, one entry per clause

do.description: harness verb (open, export, save, reopen, kill, …)

apply.description: a appname.command.v1 fragment ({kind, target?, params?}) submitted via the single mutation path

uiHarness.description: true flags a step only the ui-harness runner can execute

expect.description: inline expectation for this step (string or structured)

steps.description: ordered; each step is either a harness action (do) or an engine command (apply)

kind.description: golden = §34.1 image compare; state-hash = document hash equality; report = emitted JSON (compat/export manifest) compare; byte-identity = §7.6 canonical bytes; error = expected status/MessageId; perf = budget check
kind.x-spec-note: common kinds: golden, state-hash, report, structural, byte-identity, error, perf, probe forms; open per Part 41 assert vocabulary

tolerance.description: e.g. §34.1 max diff ≤ 1/255 + SSIM ≥ 0.999; absent = exact

expectedHistory.description: history-label MessageIds the run must produce, in order (§10.3 label rule)

wallClockS.x-spec-note: compound §52.2 budgets carry the verbatim string; single-bound rows carry the number

p95FrameMs.x-spec-note: compound §52.2 budgets carry the verbatim string; single-bound rows carry the number

maxRssMiB.x-spec-note: compound §52.2 budgets carry the verbatim string; single-bound rows carry the number

additionalProperties.x-spec-note: compound §52.2 budgets carry the verbatim string; single-bound rows carry the number

budget.description: from the workflow's §41/§52 budget lines — never invented (brief §4)

variants.description: where Part 41 names them, e.g. pseudoloc, rtl, no-gpu (W24), lowmem (W25)

x-appname-generated-from: Artifact-Pack Brief §4 (workflow manifest format) over ENGINEERING-SPEC.md Part 41 / §34.6
x-appname-rule: a PR changing normative behavior updates the document section, this artifact, its tests, and generated docs IN THE SAME PR (Appendix I). JSON cannot carry comments; the Appendix I header block travels as these x-appname-* fields.
x-spec-note: This schema is DEFINED by the v4.0 artifact pack (the spec prescribes the workflows, not a manifest wire format). Field set = the brief §4 example verbatim, plus runner/milestoneGate lifted from Part 41's per-entry lines and the §41.8 consolidated table so workflow_catalog_check can compare manifests against that table.
x-spec-note-nullability: per the v4.0 artifact convention (Appendix I): a field the spec leaves silent is null plus a note, so every non-core field admits null
